product_one_liner.value: Open Dental makes comprehensive, highly customizable dental practice management software sold at an affordable price to dental practices of any size.
product_one_liner.notes: Homepage tagline: 'Comprehensive, highly customizable dental practice management software at an affordable price for practices of any size.'

pricing_page.notes: Public Fees for Support and Services page lists software license/support fees by plan size, including Enterprise with volume discounts.

named_customers.notes: Apps Run The World's Open Dental customer list names Elevate Dental Partners (also Enamel Dentistry, Prestige Dental Centers, Christiansen Dental); a TrustRadius reviewer is at Aspen Hill Smiles Family Dentistry.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn shows 221 employees; the company's own blog history post says over 300 employees.

hq_location.notes: Contact page: Open Dental Software, 3275 Marietta St SE, Salem, OR 97317.

founded_year.notes: Employment page: 'founded in 2003 and located in Salem, Oregon'; Tracxn concurs (founded 2003 by Jordan Sparks).

eng_blog.notes: opendental.blog is a product/marketing blog (feature highlights, software-update/release-notes posts, guest posts). The only engineering-authored item is a single lone 'Questions & Answers with a Software Engineer' post from April 2023, which is not enough for True.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation page with a Quick Manual plus an API developer portal and API specification.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Careers page is open and lists roles (Dental Assistant/Software Support, Daycare Aide, Software Engineer II UI/UX-Web Developer) but none has AI, ML, data science, NLP or computer vision in the title.

model_provider.notes: Checked product docs, the AI Image Analysis integrations page, the blog, and the HIPAA/privacy pages: Open Dental's AI imaging features are third-party integrations (Pearl, BetterDiagnostics) and no AI model or model provider (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) is publicly named anywhere.

compliance_certs.notes: HIPAA page states 'Our HIPAA procedures and policies are up to date and available' and describes NIST SP800-30 risk assessments. No SOC 2, ISO 27001 or PCI DSS claim found; the GDPR page explicitly says the software needs no certification, so GDPR is not claimed.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn: 'Open Dental has not raised any funding rounds yet'; Dealroom: 'No known external funding'. amount_usd 0 and empty date are placeholders because no round exists (stage 'none').

raised_18mo.notes: Funding databases (Tracxn, Dealroom) show no outside funding at all, so nothing was raised in the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Careers page is open and lists Dental Assistant/Software Support, Daycare Aide and Software Engineer II roles; no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative or account executive openings.

launched_6mo.notes: Version 26.1 was released as stable on 08/06/2026 (blogged 2026-08-13) with major features (ODTouch 25 app release, Ensora/DoseSpot eRx support, new Pharmacies feature); the homepage already advertises Versions 26.2 and 26.3 — all within the six months before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Team page (The Org) shows a small leadership with Nathan Sparks as CEO; his profile shows CEO since January 2015 with no join/leave in the window. The only recent VP mention (VP of Development Mark Johnson) is from a Sep 2025 press release, before the 12-month window; no departure was announced.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Open Dental's own Vendors – Supplemental Services page names SmartSync's CRM integrations with GoHighLevel, HubSpot and Salesforce; these are named on the cited page, though they are ecosystem integrations rather than confirmed internal tooling.
